results.ask: What's special about my block? I'm on 46th Ave between Moraga and Noriega.
results.expect: calls about_block; gives the block's own figures and something pinned nearby, with sources; cites
results.answer:
Your block sits about 39 feet above sea level and its homes were mostly built around 1941. Two model homes from World War II stood a few blocks east: Doelger's Rainbow House on 42nd Avenue and Freedom House on 43rd Avenue, both between Moraga and Noriega.

Old photographs of your corner are in the OpenSFHistory archive: two at 46th and Moraga and three at 45th and Noriega. You can open them at [OpenSFHistory / wnp58.929](https://opensfhistory.org/Display/wnp58.929.jpg), [OpenSFHistory / wnp58.923](https://opensfhistory.org/Display/wnp58.923.jpg), [OpenSFHistory / wnp07.00404](https://opensfhistory.org/Display/wnp07.00404.jpg), [OpenSFHistory / wnp30.0124](https://opensfhistory.org/Display/wnp30.0124.jpg), and [OpenSFHistory / wnp58.947](https://opensfhistory.org/Display/wnp58.947.jpg).

Street cleaning is Mon 1st & 3rd on the east side (next 11/16) and Thu 1st, 3rd, 5th on the west side (next 11/19). The signs on the block are the last word.
